key.name: ocr-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut to grab text from the screen
key.description: Pressing this shortcut opens the GNOME area-screenshot UI and, once you select a region, writes the recognised text to the clipboard. Empty by default: set it in the extension's settings.

key.name: log-text
key.summary: Store recognised text in the job log
key.description: When off, the job log records only the length of the recognised text. Screen OCR can capture passwords and other secrets, so this is off by default.
